letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. The way you laugh, the way you care, makes even the sand dunes feel like home. As we mark another day together—though the calendar stays shy—my heart shouts louder than any desert wind. Thank you for being my partner in adventure, love, and endless tea. I adore you more with each passing moment.
poem:
In dunes or by the Sabarmati’s flow,  
Your smile makes every season glow.  
Hand in hand, we chase the sky,  
Love’s our compass, you and I.
